system.description: This spell creates a mass of stone equal to 1,000 cubic feet; it may be arranged in any fashion the caster desires (10'x 10' x 10' block, 25'x 20'x 2'wall, etc.). If the wall is attacked, it has a number of hit points equal to the level of the caster. A rust monster can destroy a wall of iron with a single touch. Otherwise, the wall can only be damaged by battering; see Chapter 9 (page 118) for more on battering attacks. Casting time varies depending on the complexity of the design. A simple wall and other simple shapes take 1 round. A simple staircase may take 10 rounds (1 turn).
